```{r load-packages}
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.core)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

```{r simulate-data}
#### Simulate Vitals Data with Duplicates ####
# Site-level duplicate rates are intentionally extreme to produce realistic flag patterns.
# Flags require Z > 2 (flag=1) or Z > 3 (flag=2) via normal approximation vs. overall mean.
# Key insight: having many high-rate sites inflates the overall mean and suppresses Z-scores,
# so we use 1-2 extreme sites and keep most sites very clean.
set.seed(42)

n_visits <- 10
subjects <- paste0("S", sprintf("%03d", 1:120))
sites    <- paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", rep(1:12, each = 10)))

Mapped_SUBJ <- data.frame(subjid = subjects, invid = sites, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

vs_rows <- expand.grid(subjid = subjects, visit = 1:n_visits, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vs_rows$vs_dt  <- as.Date("2024-01-01") + (vs_rows$visit - 1) * 30
vs_rows$weight <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 75,   10),  1)
vs_rows$height <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 170,  10),  1)
vs_rows$bmi    <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 25,    4),  1)
vs_rows$sysbp  <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 125,  15),  0)
vs_rows$diabp  <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 80,   10),  0)
vs_rows$pulse  <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 72,   12),  0)
vs_rows$temp   <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 36.8,  0.4), 1)
vs_rows$resp   <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 16,    3),  0)

site_map <- setNames(Mapped_SUBJ$invid, Mapped_SUBJ$subjid)

# Inject duplicates for each subject at a per-site rate.
# Copies a prior-visit value into a later visit (exact match = duplicate).
inject_dups <- function(values, subjects, site_rates, site_map) {
  for (subj in unique(subjects)) {
    idx <- which(subjects == subj)
    if (length(idx) <= 1) next
    r <- site_rates[[site_map[subj]]]
    n_dup <- round(length(idx[-1]) * r)
    if (n_dup <= 0) next
    dup_pos <- sample(idx[-1], min(n_dup, length(idx[-1])))
    for (p in dup_pos) {
      prior <- idx[idx < p]
      values[p] <- values[sample(prior, 1)]
    }
  }
  values
}

# Site duplicate rates — one extreme site per KRI measure (different site each time)
# to get Flag=2 (red). The overdispersion correction in Analyze_NormalApprox requires
# a SINGLE extreme site (all others low) to produce Z > 3.
#
# weight — SITE01 is the problem site
weight_rates <- as.list(setNames(
  c(0.90, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00),
  paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

# sysbp — SITE02 is the problem site (different from weight for visual variety)
sysbp_rates <- as.list(setNames(
  c(0.03, 0.90, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00),
  paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

# diabp — SITE03 is the problem site
diabp_rates <- as.list(setNames(
  c(0.03, 0.03, 0.90, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00),
  paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

# Other measures — mild background noise only
mild_rates <- as.list(setNames(rep(0.04, 12), paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

vs_rows$weight <- inject_dups(vs_rows$weight, vs_rows$subjid, weight_rates, site_map)
vs_rows$height <- inject_dups(vs_rows$height, vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)
vs_rows$bmi    <- inject_dups(vs_rows$bmi,    vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)
vs_rows$sysbp  <- inject_dups(vs_rows$sysbp,  vs_rows$subjid, sysbp_rates,  site_map)
vs_rows$diabp  <- inject_dups(vs_rows$diabp,  vs_rows$subjid, diabp_rates,  site_map)
vs_rows$pulse  <- inject_dups(vs_rows$pulse,  vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)
vs_rows$temp   <- inject_dups(vs_rows$temp,   vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)
vs_rows$resp   <- inject_dups(vs_rows$resp,   vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)

Mapped_VS <- vs_rows[, c("subjid", "vs_dt", "weight", "height", "bmi",
                          "sysbp", "diabp", "pulse", "temp", "resp")]
```

```{r compute-metrics}
#### Helper to run a duplicate-rate pipeline ####
run_duplicate_pipeline <- function(df, dfSubjects, strValueCol, strMetricID, strMetricLabel) {
  flagged <- Flag_Duplicates(
    df = df, strSubjectCol = "subjid", strDateCol = "vs_dt", strValueCol = strValueCol
  )
  input <- gsm.core::Input_Rate(
    dfSubjects = dfSubjects, dfNumerator = flagged, dfDenominator = flagged,
    strSubjectCol = "subjid", strGroupCol = "invid", strGroupLevel = "Site",
    strNumeratorMethod = "Sum", strNumeratorCol = "is_duplicate", strDenominatorMethod = "Count"
  )
  transformed <- gsm.core::Transform_Rate(input)
  analyzed    <- gsm.core::Analyze_NormalApprox(transformed, strType = "binary")
  flagged_out <- gsm.core::Flag_NormalApprox(analyzed, vThreshold = c(2, 3), vFlag = c(0, 1, 2))
  data.frame(
    GroupID    = flagged_out$GroupID,
    GroupLevel = flagged_out$GroupLevel,
    Numerator  = flagged_out$Numerator,
    Denominator = flagged_out$Denominator,
    Metric     = flagged_out$Metric,
    Score      = flagged_out$Score,
    Flag       = flagged_out$Flag,
    MetricID   = strMetricID,
    SnapshotDate = Sys.Date(),
    StudyID    = "SIM001",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

kri0016_results <- run_duplicate_pipeline(Mapped_VS, Mapped_SUBJ, "weight", "Analysis_kri0016", "Duplicate Weight Record Rate")
kri0017_results <- run_duplicate_pipeline(Mapped_VS, Mapped_SUBJ, "sysbp",  "Analysis_kri0017", "Duplicate Systolic BP Record Rate")
kri0018_results <- run_duplicate_pipeline(Mapped_VS, Mapped_SUBJ, "diabp",  "Analysis_kri0018", "Duplicate Diastolic BP Record Rate")

dfReportingResults <- rbind(
  gsm.core::reportingResults[, names(kri0016_results)],
  kri0016_results,
  kri0017_results,
  kri0018_results
)

new_metrics <- data.frame(
  MetricID = c("Analysis_kri0016", "Analysis_kri0017", "Analysis_kri0018"),
  Metric   = c("Duplicate Weight Record Rate", "Duplicate Systolic BP Record Rate",
               "Duplicate Diastolic BP Record Rate"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
dfReportingMetrics <- rbind(
  gsm.core::reportingMetrics[, intersect(names(gsm.core::reportingMetrics), names(new_metrics)), drop = FALSE],
  new_metrics[, intersect(names(gsm.core::reportingMetrics), names(new_metrics)), drop = FALSE]
)
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
#### Generate Record Duplication Report ####
w <- Report_RecordDuplication(
  dfMappedVS = Mapped_VS,
  dfMappedSUBJ = Mapped_SUBJ,
  vMeasuresVS = c("weight", "height", "bmi", "sysbp", "diabp", "pulse", "temp", "resp"),
  dfReportingResults = dfReportingResults,
  dfReportingMetrics = dfReportingMetrics,
  strGroupLevel = "Site"
)
w
```
